levels.label: Kindergarten
levels.notation: None. Words and pictures only. Numerals 0–10.
levels.voice: Second person, present tense, 6–12 word sentences. Every module ends with one thing to do.

levels.label: 2nd grade
levels.voice: Warmth, two-step chains. Introduces the idea that a rule must work every time.

levels.label: 5th grade
levels.voice: The turn to why. Discussion/Proof shape introduced. First symbols, always glossed.

levels.label: 8th grade
levels.voice: Pre-algebra fluency assumed. Proofs are real proofs, in paragraphs, 3–8 sentences.

levels.label: 9th grade
levels.voice: Algebra I complete. Quantifiers introduced. Proofs a paragraph or two.

levels.label: 10th grade
levels.notation: Adds ≡, ∃!, f⁻¹, ∘, Σ, ℕ ℤ ℚ ℝ ℂ.
levels.voice: Geometry-year reader. Explicitly connects to two-column proofs. First abstract arguments.

levels.label: 12th grade
levels.voice: Precalculus/calculus reader. Very close to Math 0 in rigor. Complete Discussion sections.

levels.label: College
levels.notation: Full Math 0 notation, plus forward references.
levels.voice: Math 0 as intended. WhereThisGoes closer on every module.
